headings.text: Tell your clinician what matters to you. Ask what happens next and who to contact with questions afterwards.
Find the next step for your care.
Tell your clinician what matters to you. Ask what happens next and who to contact with questions afterwards.
It meant a lot to have time to explain what was on my mind.
Having someone beside me made it easier to ask the questions I had been holding back.
I left with my questions written down and a clearer idea of what to ask next.

findings.message: 3 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.
Remove unless it is a real drop zone.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (80px, 100px, 112px, 771px, 847px, 1034px, 836px); the three most used hold only 58% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
